scope: Retained built-in public-source support bundles. No private imports, saved projects or poll records.
source_boundary: These are the retained workbench source bundles, source manifests and explicitly derived model/context assets. They are not all unmodified publisher downloads; their original manifests retain publisher identities, transformations and limits.
preservation: Original relative paths, lengths and SHA-256 are retained. Transfer gzip is reversible packaging only. Multi-part files reassemble in listed order. No source observation, matrix entry, flag or metadata is removed.
